text: Entry Requirements 1.Be a non-Chinese citizen in good health; 2. Be a high school graduate or its equivalent, no younger than 18 years. 3. Should comply with the regulations (JW〔2020〕No. 12) issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. HSK 5(>180 score) or above is required. HSK 4 (>180 score) is accepted for International Chinese language education program.
